# Getting started

This section shows you how to install and run sqlpipe.

## Install

To install sqlpipe, run this command:

```
curl -sSL https://get.sqlpipe.dev | sh
```

The command downloads the sqlpipe binary and puts it in your path.

## Configure

Make a file with the name `sqlpipe.yaml` in your project directory. In the file, set these values:

- The source database URL
- The target database URL
- The tables to copy

For an example configuration, see the sqlpipe documentation.

## First run

Before you start the first run, make sure that the source and target databases are available.

To start sqlpipe, run this command:

```
sqlpipe run --config sqlpipe.yaml
```

sqlpipe reads the configuration file and copies the data from the source to the target. When the run is complete, sqlpipe shows a summary of the rows that it copied.

If sqlpipe shows an error, examine the log and correct the configuration file.
